newsitem.title: IRAN: "Missing" Iranian journalist turns up in Tehran.
newsitem.headline: "Missing" Iranian journalist turns up in Tehran.

text.p: An Iranian journalist who was "missing" for almost two months when he failed to arrive in Germany as expected turned up at Tehran airport on Friday and said he had been in Germany dealing with family problems.

Iranian writers in exile in Germany had accused Tehran of detaining Faraj Sarkuhi as he prepared to board a flight to Germany on November 3 but Iran had always insisted the journalist got on the plane as planned.

Sarkuhi, the editor of the monthly Adineh, said he kept his arrival in Germany a secret because he and his wife -- who lives in Germany -- had "problems" and he was trying to arrange to take custody of their children.
He said that he had not contacted his wife during his visit.
German authorities had also said they believed the journalist never left Iran and tried to gather more information.

The journalist said that two weeks ago Iranian authorities contacted him in Cologne and he explained the situation. "They assured me that I can safely return home, no charge will be pressed against me."
When journalists asked to see Sarkuhi's passport, he said he had given it to someone in Turkmenistan to help him secure a Canadian visa.
Sarkuhi had taken part in efforts to set up an independent writers' union in Iran.
